scope: Diagnose Task38 learnability, not a complete compartment. 18 explicit physical gates, dt0.1ms, unchanged readout, imposed V/Ca bridge with correct phase. Width32 fixed; historical width64 retained only as frozen diagnostic comparator.
architecture: Task38 width32 and identical paired initial weights. Factorized arms zero state-context features entering candidate/fraction heads, including old-SK context; physical old states remain in the convex update. No canonical rates at candidate inference. Effective capacity differs by dependency mask, not a speed comparison.
sampling: Per family and role, fixed windows: half uniform starts, half input-transition enriched (abs dV>1mV or abs dlog10Ca>0.05, plus initial/final 25 ticks), random training-only offset up to 7 ticks. Fit and extra windows generated independently. Common family/window draws and 50% extra-role Bernoulli across members; fit-only arms always use fit. No histories cross partitions. Coverage changes distinct histories (4 to 8 per family), not the update or target count.
loss: All arms process the same eight targets per update. TF uses true old states at each tick; FR uses only true initial state then its predictions. Base objective is normalized gate MSE plus individual-current MSE with frozen fit-only Task38 normalizers. Gate-only anchor removes current term. Relative anchor adds current MSE normalized by each training window/channel reference peak (floor1e-7). No evaluation threshold changed.
selection: Per-member minimum max(common TF eight-target base loss, common FR eight-target base loss) on fixed development windows; same score for every arm including anchors. Earliest tie. Full long recurrence and stress only after selection freeze, no reselection. Every checkpoint retained for budget curves. Historical Task38 is a comparator, not an exactly matched sampling control.

hypotheses.coverage: Independent extra training histories improve errors at matched updates, targets and sampler.
hypotheses.exposure: Free-running supervision reduces exposure mismatch versus teacher-forced training on identical eight-target windows.
hypotheses.bias: Suppressing irrelevant state-context dependencies improves learnability while retaining explicit gate memory.
hypotheses.current_supervision: Individual current supervision helps relative to gate-only supervision on the matched fit/TF/joint anchor.
hypotheses.small_currents: Window-relative auxiliary current loss helps weak-current strata versus matched fit/FR/joint base loss without excusing absolute errors.
hypotheses.budget: Short-sequence errors keep improving between30k and60k at fixed data; a trend does not prove eventual long-horizon success or unlimited scaling.

planned_contrasts: Coverage, FR and bias paired across the other two factors (12 edges); two anchor loss contrasts. Report three paired seed ratios, median and worst recurrence severity. Support requires >=20% median reduction, improvement in all3 seeds and worst-severity regression<=5%; no claim of population-level significance. Budget contrast uses common development sequence score at30k vs60k with same20%/3seed rule, not a long-rollout claim.
quality: Task37 thresholds copied unchanged through Task38 evaluator. Development pass is conjunction over24 trajectories x3 seeds and every channel/gate; stress separate. Report weak-current strata (reference scale<=1e-6) and active strata separately. Full recovery through10s, history contrasts, timing and charge remain required. Unsupported events are not certified behaviors.
severity: Per case max(gate RMSE/0.005, gate max/0.03, each channel NRMSE/0.01, nmax/0.05, signed/absolute charge normalized/0.02). Paired diagnostic score is median of case severities per seed; worst retained separately. Timing and occupancy still enter strict evaluator pass, even though not this diagnostic score.
probes: After freeze: off-manifold fit-domain random-state oracle error; off-diagonal state sensitivity at fixed V/Ca, occupancy, blocked currents, matched-history contrast, near-zero versus active current errors. These are diagnostics, not selection or additional fresh confirmation.
execution: One vectorized30-member module, independent parameters/Adam moments and member-wise clipping. FP32 deterministic, TF32 off. Optional single compiled training objective must pass forward AND gradient equivalence; eager fallback recorded. Same execution mode for all arms. CUDA graph scanner checks65 ticks across chunk boundaries before full training. No NEURON imports. Compact progress every1000 updates.
preflights: Task37 manifest hashes; Task38 freeze/checkpoint and normalizer hashes; reference phases; batched vs isolated Adam across all arm types; factorized state-context invariance; no Ca leakage into V gates; blocked currents; gradients finite; eight-step target exposure counts equal; CUDA graph/eager recurrence equivalence. Abort technical violations before training.
limits: Existing development/stress are open diagnostics; no independent confirmation generated or accessed. No autonomous V/Ca, no emergent spike/bifurcation claim, no speedup claim. Task40 remains blocked on quality failure. Data diversity, optimizer budget, supervision and representation are not interchangeable explanations. 60k is a bounded diagnostic budget, not a promise to solve every rare regime.
